newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bomb attack damages Corsican law courts.
newsitem.headline: Bomb attack damages Corsican law courts.

text.p: A bomb attack by suspected separatist guerrillas damaged the entrance to the law courts in the Corsican town of Corte early on Tuesday but there were no injuries, police said.
The attack bore the hallmarks of the outlawed Corsican National Liberation Front (FLNC)-Historic Wing, which has stepped up a two-decade-old campaign for greater autonomy from France.
